body.label: Target
body.html: One detected enemy within ranged Weapon Range, along a clear path around one obstacle.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Measure range along the shot's bent path. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage. The shot cannot pass through solid material.

surges.html: On a hit, move the target 1 unit away from the final segment of the shot.

rider.title: Lock - Trickshot
rider.html: After resolving, you may maintain an existing Lock along this same clear bent path until your next turn, even without direct sight.
